caption: The drawing depicts a large, ornate pitcher with a wide spout and a curved handle, rendered in shades of gray on a beige background. The surface of the pitcher features detailed relief images: a central standing human figure who appears to be grasping or restraining another human at a lower position, with at least two additional partial figures visible, one of whom is bent over and another standing upright, and there is what looks like a fence, posts, or rails as part of the scene. Some parts of the relief are labeled with small text. The pitcher has a flared rim and sits on a flat round base. Below and slightly to the right of the main pitcher, there is a smaller, simpler line drawing of a similar pitcher, showing another relief scene and the words “ENGLAND HER CONSTITUTION” displayed prominently above the figures. The drawing is signed “E.A. Sheddady 1867” near the base of the larger pitcher and features no coloration beyond the grayscale pencil rendering. The background consists of plain, unmarked paper.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
